answer: Each agent identity must post a non-refundable bond before it can transact, slashed when a cluster of identities is caught coordinating as one wallet. A Sybil farmer minting a thousand wallets must fund a thousand bonds from the same reserve, so cost scales linearly with each fake identity while honest agents reclaim theirs on exit. Like a tide pulling back, slashing exposes the fake layer. Picture an opal: thin layers, cheap to fake alone, costly to stack all. The quill signing an honest answer costs nothing extra; the one signing a forged swarm runs out of capital.
